    Fanography 3-Folds¶

    This section records all 105 smooth Fano threefold families from Fanography. 81 of the 105 families carry exact computed ambient quantum multiplication operators and connection-exponent data in GEOATOMS: 20 flag-variety and homogeneous-bundle realizations computed in gwflags, and 62 smooth toric and toric complete-intersection presentations computed in gwtoric (with family 2-32 realized in both models, and 12 additional flag entries independently cross-verified symbolically in gwtoric). The remaining 24 families are listed as Catalog only reference entries.

    Realization types. Entries realized directly via root systems and homogeneous bundles display their gwflags inputs and A(1) A ( 1 ) matrices inline below. Entries realized via smooth projective toric fans and nef complete intersections link directly to their dedicated record pages (toric-threefolds.json) with exact ray/cone inputs, symbolic operators A(y) A ( y ) , and connection exponents. Catalog-only entries provide geometric descriptions without a computed matrix.

    The inline matrices display A(1) A ( 1 ) , first-Chern quantum multiplication on the returned ambient space, with columns as images of the ordered basis. The returned grading is G=diag(codimei−dim⁡X/2) G = diag ( codim e i − dim ⁡ X / 2 ) . Spectral tables state their own parameter point. See notation and scope and Algebraic-geometry databases.

    Fano Variety 1-1¶

    1-1

    Description: Double cover of P3 P 3 with branch locus a divisor of degree 6. (ρ(X)=1 ρ ( X ) = 1 , (−KX)3=2 ( − K X ) 3 = 2 , h1,2(X)=52 h 1 , 2 ( X ) = 52 ). Realization type: Catalog only — outside the current flag and positive-toric complete-intersection models.
